AAP releases first list of 40 Punjab candidates; several MLAs resign

The Aam Aadmi Party announced its first list of 40 candidates for the 2027 Punjab assembly elections, naming Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann to contest from Dhuri and jailed minister Sanjeev Arora to contest from Ludhiana West; within two days of the announcement two sitting AAP MLAs, Chetan Jouramajra and Harmeet Pathanmajra, quit the party and a third MLA, Kunwar Vijay Pratap Singh, resigned after being suspended, while a murder in Mansa was reported as potentially damaging AAP's standing and an MLA claimed the party had strayed from its founding ideals.
